title: Medefaidrin
description: Sacred language of the Obɛri Ɔkaimɛ Ibibio community
extract: Medefaidrin (Medefidrin), or Obɛri Ɔkaimɛ, is a constructed language and script created as a Christian sacred language by an Ibibio congregation in 1930s Nigeria. It has its roots in glossolalia.
